quickcraft.config.mod_support.comment.ch: §6Function: §rChecks §bModrinth§r at launch for short notices enabled by the author; each notice is shown only once.
screen.quickcraft.title: QuickCraft Config §cHint: click [+] to expand more settings
quickcraft.config.crafting.comment.enabl:
§6Function: §rMaster toggle for jet-style crafting in the workbench screen.
§eUsage: §rBind a hotkey in the general hotkey settings.
§eUsage: §rSelect a recipe in the workbench recipe book, then press the hotkey.
§7Note: §rNo need to save recipes first like §bItemScroller§r.
§7Option: §rYou can choose whether to drop results when crafting stops.
§cCompatibility: Disable IPN Continuous Crafting (auto refill) and Item Scroller's clientCraftingFixOn1.12 to avoid interrupted crafting.

§6Function: §rBox Jet: fills the 3x3 grid straight from shulker materials and throws the results out.
§eUsage: §rThe workbench title bar switches between §bNormal Jet§r and §bBox Jet§r.
§cRequirement: §rEnable §bQuick Shulker§r on the §bMod Support§r tab; both client and server must support it.
§7Rules: §rSingle-material boxes; item components must match the recipe; §crecipes returning materials cannot use Box Jet§r.
§7Note: §rNo box screen, no inventory slot; refills and storing ignore locked slots.
§cWarning: Do not enable unless needed.
quickcraft.config.crafting.comment.workb:
§6Function: §rControls how many operations Box Jet merges per batch, trading speed for stability.
§7Note: §rThe three modes barely differ in stability but do change the packets sent per second.
§cWarning: Do not change unless needed.
quickcraft.config.crafting.comment.enabl:
§6Function: §rIn Box Jet, stores results from the output slot straight into a shulker box, bypassing the inventory.
§eUsage: §rThe result button in the workbench title bar toggles §bStore in Box§r and §bDrop on Ground§r.
§7Rules: §rPrefers a same-result-only box, then an empty one; locked boxes work; swaps when a full result can't fit.
§7Note: §rStops and keeps the result when no box is available.
§cWarning: Do not enable unless needed.

§6Function: §rMaster toggle for jet-style crafting in the player 2x2 grid.
§eUsage: §rBind a hotkey under §bHotkeys§r.
§eUsage: §rSelect a recipe in the backpack §brecipe book§r, then press the hotkey.
§7Note: §rNo need to save recipes first like §bItemScroller§r.
§7Option: §rYou can choose whether to drop results when crafting stops.
§cCompatibility: Disable IPN Continuous Crafting (auto refill) and Item Scroller's clientCraftingFixOn1.12 to avoid interrupted crafting.

§6Function: §rMaster toggle for jet-style crafting in the stonecutter screen.
§eUsage: §rBind a hotkey under §bHotkeys§r.
§eUsage: §rSelect a recipe in the stonecutter screen, then press the hotkey.
§7Note: §rNo need to save recipes first like §bItemScroller§r.
§7Option: §rYou can choose whether to drop results when crafting stops.
§cCompatibility: Disable IPN Continuous Crafting (auto refill) to avoid disrupting refills and recipe selection.

§6Function: §rRemembers the left anvil item and target name, then refills and renames items in bulk.
§eAction: §rSet the target name, then use the §bSingle Craft§r or §bRapid Craft§r hotkey.
§7Results: §rFills the inventory first; when full, clears matching results once and throws from the result slot.
§7Note: §rA locked input or output slot stops the run; whether results drop on stop follows Drop Results on Stop.
§cLimit: §rRenaming only, enchanting is not automated and experience is still required.
§7Note: §rRebind it under §bHotkeys§r.
quickcraft.config.crafting.comment.craft:
§6Function: §rCaps continuous crafting speed for crafting tables, the 2x2 grid, stonecutters and anvils.
§eRange: §rIngredient batches per second, 0–100, default 50; §b0§r means no limit.
§7Note: §rSingle crafts are unaffected and a batch may yield several items; actual speed depends on server TPS and latency.
quickcraft.config.crafting.comment.showC:
§6Function: §rShows a small button at the lower-right of the workbench, 2x2 grid and stonecutter output slot.
§eClick: §rSame as Single Craft.
§eRapid: §rHold §bAlt + Button§r to start rapid crafting; release to stop.
§eShown: §rThe button stays hidden while the matching jet crafting switch is off.
quickcraft.config.crafting.comment.dropC: §6Function: §rWhen single or rapid crafting §bends§r, immediately drops the current crafted result from the inventory.
quickcraft.config.crafting.comment.retai:
§6Function: §rDuring ordinary workbench and backpack 2x2 refills, right-clicks each ingredient source for half a stack.
§7Note: §rKeeps at least 1 item in every ingredient slot, never emptying the source.
§7Limit: §rOnly ordinary crafting; Box Jet, stonecutters and anvils are unchanged.
quickcraft.config.container_tools.commen:
§6Function: §rEnables click and slide quick transfer.
§eMatching Transfer: §rHold §bAlt + Left Click§r and click or slide items to transfer by type in bulk.
§eStack Transfer: §rHold §bShift + Left Click§r and click or slide over slots to transfer a whole stack.
§eNote: §rBoth bindings can be changed under §bHotkeys§r.

§6Function: §rWhile hovering an item, shades every matching slot in the container and player inventory.
§eNote: §rItems differing in enchantments or names do not match; color and opacity are adjustable and transfers are unchanged.
quickcraft.config.container_tools.pretty: Matching Transfer Highlight Color and Opacity
quickcraft.config.container_tools.name.m: Matching Transfer Highlight Color and Opacity
quickcraft.config.container_tools.commen:
§6Function: §rSets the color and opacity of the matching-item slot highlight.
§eFormat: §rA is opacity: 0 is fully transparent, 255 fully opaque; §b#AARRGGBB§r is also accepted.

§6Function: §rShows a portable storage sidebar in the survival inventory: shulkers, ender chest, bundles.
§eUsage: §r§bLeft Click§r takes one, §bright click§r or §bShift + Left Click§r takes a whole stack to the inventory.
§eUsage: §rDrag onto the sidebar to store; hold §bSpace + Left Click§r and click items to store them.
§cRequirement: §rShulker box and ender chest transfers need §bQuick Shulker§r.
§7Note: §rHidden while the recipe book is open; off by default.

§6Function: §rExpands the portable storage sidebar when the inventory opens.
§eOff: §rThe sidebar starts collapsed and can be expanded by its button.

§6Function: §rSets the §bcolumn count§r of the sidebar grid.
§7Note: §rFewer columns are shown when the window is narrow.

§6Function: §rSets the §brow count§r of the sidebar grid.
§7Note: §rFewer rows are shown when the window is short.

§6Function: §rRefills a used hand item from the inventory and carried shulker boxes.
§eRequirement: §rBox refills require opening boxes with §bQuick Shulker§r.
§7Note: §r§bIPN§r, §bTweakeroo§r, and Easy Place refills take priority.
quickcraft.portable_storage.toggle: Portable storage panel: click to expand or collapse
quickcraft.portable_storage.ender_refres: Click the ender chest icon below to refresh
quickcraft.portable_storage.unavailable: Quick Shulker is missing or the server does not support it
quickcraft.portable_storage.no_source: No usable portable container or matching item
quickcraft.portable_storage.carrier_chan: The carried container moved or was replaced
quickcraft.portable_storage.cursor_busy: Put the item on your cursor away first
quickcraft.portable_storage.locked_slot: The slot or container is locked
quickcraft.portable_storage.bundle_selec: This item cannot be taken from a bundle
quickcraft.config.container_tools.commen:
§6Function: §rShows §bQuick Stash§r and retrieve buttons in container screens.
§eUse: §rThe top button stashes matching inventory items; the bottom takes container items back.
§eAlt: §rHold §bAlt + left click§r to stash that area's items into shulker boxes instead.
§eRequires: §rBox stashing needs §bQuick Shulker§r and uses boxes in that area already holding the item.
§7Note: §rIn the inventory screen, click §bStash into shulker boxes§r directly.

§6Function: §rTransfers items by scrolling the mouse wheel over slots.
§eUsage: §rPlain scroll moves 1, §bAlt§r moves matching items, §bShift§r moves a whole stack.
§eDirection: §rUp moves items out of the hovered side, down moves them back.
§7Memory: §rKeep scrolling after the slot empties or scroll back; leaving the slot or closing the screen clears it.
§cCompatibility: takes over IPN and Item Scroller wheel transfers on these slots while enabled.

§6Function: §rHold the hotkey and click or slide slots to leave 1 item on the source side.
§eNote: §rOnly between containers and the player inventory; it does not take over vanilla §bShift§r transfer.
§7Note: §rRebind it under §bHotkeys§r.

§6Function: §rKeeps vanilla §bQ§r and enables custom drop hotkeys.
§eDrop Stack: §rPress §bShift + Q§r.
§eDrop Matching: §rPress §bCtrl + Q§r.
Note: change the bindings under §bHotkeys§r.

§6Function: §r§bRight click§ring a villager completes all favorited trades in favorite order.
§eRequires: §r§bFavorite Trade§r on and trades favorited.
§7Note: §rOnly affects §bright click§rs on villagers; no favorites means nothing happens.
§6Function: §rRight click an offer in the villager screen to complete as many trades as possible.

§6Function: §rNear a villager with favorited trades, opens the screen and completes them.
§eRequirement: §rEnable §bFavorite Trade§r and favorite that villager's trades.
§7Note: §rIndependent from Quick Trade; only Favorite Trade is needed.

§6Function: §rPress §bMiddle Button§r on a trade to favorite it.
§eNote: §rMultiple favorites are pinned in favorite order; press the §bmiddle button§r again to unfavorite one.

§6Function: §rPress the sort hotkey or click §bSort Container§r / §bSort Inventory§r to sort the hovered area.
§7Rule: §rShulker boxes go last by default; enchanted elytra and diamond/netherite gear come first.
§eNote: §rThe same ordering rules drive cross-box sorting.
§7Note: §rRebind it under §bHotkeys§r.
§6Function: §rShows sort buttons in chest, shulker box, and player inventory screens.

§6Function: §rSets items to place at the front while sorting, in list order.
§eFormat: §rOne name per line: Chinese name, English name, full ID, or short ID, e.g. §bElytra§r or §bdiamond_sword§r.
§7Note: §r§bEnchanted Elytra§r matches enchanted items only; names match exactly; an empty list adds no top priority.

§6Function: §rSets items placed after normal items while sorting, in list order.
§eFormat: §rA current-language name, a Chinese/English mapped name, full ID, or short ID, e.g. §bStick§r or §bdiamond_sword§r.
§7Note: §rEmpty by default; with boxes forced to the end these items come first, otherwise they sort normally.
quickcraft.config.container_tools.pretty: Sort Shulker Boxes to the End
quickcraft.config.container_tools.name.q: Sort Shulker Boxes to the End
quickcraft.config.container_tools.commen:
§6Function: §rWhen on, shulker boxes go to the end of the sorted area.
§eOff: §rBoxes follow creative-tab order, so a purple box may come before a grass block.
§7Note: §rThe existing ordering between shulker boxes is preserved.

§6Function: §rWhen enabled, bundles are placed at the end of the sorted area.
§eWhen disabled: §rBundles follow creative-tab category order; bundles are still ordered by their contents.
§7Note: §r1.21.1 and earlier need the experimental bundle feature; 1.21.3+ and 26.x work directly.

§6Function: §rShows the lock-all button in supported container and player inventory screens.
§eNote: §rThe inventory area of container screens gets its own inventory lock.
§7Note: §rIt shares state with the inventory screen; turning this off only hides the button and keeps lock states.

§6Function: §rShows small locks at the top-right of supported container and player inventory slots.
§7Note: §rLocked slots are skipped by sorting, stashing, cross-box sorting, and other QuickCraft or mod automation.
§7Note: §rTurning this off only hides the locks; existing lock states are kept.
§6Function: §rSets how long fill outlines stay in the world.

§6Function: §rBriefly marks targets and results in the world during projection filling and container copying.
§7Note: §rBlue is filling, green finished, yellow still missing items, gray stopped, red failed.
§6Function: §rAllow manual moves and swaps of items in locked slots.

§6Function: §rMaster right-click switch for container tool mode.
§eNote: §rWhen on, right clicks on containers and inventory shulkers run the mode below.
§7Rebind: §rChange the binding under §bHotkeys§r.

§6Function: §rClick to cycle Quick Stash, Container Copy, Quick Clear, and Quick Fill.
§7§bQuick Stash§r: §rStash matching inventory items back into the container.
§bQuick Clear§r: §rDrop the container's contents onto the ground.
§7§bContainer Copy§r: §rMiddle click to record a template, right click matching containers to fill.
§7§bQuick Fill§r: §rFill it with the most abundant inventory item.

§6Function: §r§bRight click§r a shulker in your inventory to stash matching inventory items into it.
§eRequires: §rQuick Stash mode and §bQuick Shulker§r support enabled.

§6Function: §rQuick Stash uses Quick Shulker to pack items into boxes in the container area.
§eNote: §rSingle-item boxes are stashed whole; mixed boxes only give the items the container accepts.
§eOrder: §rLoose items go into boxes already holding the same item, then normal container slots.

§6Function: §r§bRight click§r a shulker in your inventory to drop its contents as whole stacks.
§eRequires: §rQuick Clear mode and §bQuick Shulker§r support enabled.

§6Function: §r§bRight click§r a shulker in your inventory to add the most abundant inventory item.
§eRequires: §rQuick Fill mode and §bQuick Shulker§r support enabled.

§6Function: §rIn Creative, hold an item and press §bCtrl + G§r to get a filled shulker box.
§eUsage: §rEmpty off hand makes a shulker box; a held container is filled; a bundle is stuffed.
§7Note: §rA main-hand shulker box yields a chest of shulker boxes;
§7Rebind: §rChange the binding under §bHotkeys§r.

§6Function: §rSets how many stacks each §bCtrl + G§r puts into the off-hand bundle.
§7Note: §rStops automatically when the bundle is full.

§6Function: §rAllows packing a container or bundle that already holds items.
§eOff: §rHolding a filled container and pressing §bCtrl + G§r packs nothing.
§eOn: §rPacks one more layer; packing the result again is blocked to avoid a crash.

§6Function: §rLets the §bTweakeroo§r free camera crosshair interact with blocks, entities, and schematics.
§cRequirement: §rEnable §bFree Camera Player Inputs§r on Tweakeroo's Generic page.
§7Note: §rWithout it, you cannot place blocks or open containers from the free camera view.
§eRange: §rUses the real position and server range; out-of-range targets are skipped.

§6Function: §rUses, places, and breaks blocks from the free camera view.
§eNote: §rIncludes opening containers, using functional blocks, and transforming blocks with tools.

§6Function: §rInteracts with or attacks entities from the free camera view.
§eNote: §rCovers trading, riding, feeding, and other vanilla actions; you cannot target yourself.

§6Function: §rLets §bLitematica§r easy place pick schematic targets from the free camera view.
§eRequires: §rLitematica must be installed with easy place enabled.

§6Function: §r§bRight click§ring a beacon supplies materials and activates it automatically.
§eNote: §rWhen materials are short, matching mineral blocks are broken down to fill the gap.
§7Effect: §rActivates the next effect in the order that is not active yet.
§7Regeneration: §rLevel II in 1.21 and 26.1–26.1.2; from 26.2, level II in singleplayer and Haste I + Regeneration I in multiplayer.

§6Function: §rSets the effect order to prioritize when auto activating beacons.
§eNote: §rFills the next missing effect starting from entry 1, up to 6; English IDs and Chinese names are supported.
§bEnglish: §rhaste2, strength2, regeneration
§bEnglish: §rjump_boost2, speed2, resistance2
§bChinese: §r急迫2、力量2、生命恢复
§bChinese: §r跳跃提升2、迅捷2、抗性提升2
quickcraft.config.projection_tools.comme:
§6Function: §rEnables 3D previews for §bLitematica§r schematics and area selections.
§7Note: §rThe first read of a .litematic file builds a preview cache.

§6Function: §rTurns off §bIris§r shaders when opening a schematic or area 3D preview.
§7Note: §rDisabling shaders reloads the render pipeline and may briefly stutter.
§7Note: §rShaders stay off after leaving the preview; they do not come back automatically.

§6Function: §rCopies a complete §bLitematica§r mode 1 area into a schematic at its original position.
§eUse: §rSet a complete area, then press §bCtrl + C§r; change the key on the Hotkey Bindings page.
§7Note: §rDisabling blocks new copy tasks but leaves existing temporary schematics alone.
§7Note: §rRebind it under §bHotkeys§r.

§6Function: §rAllows generating, choosing, or removing preview images in the §b3D preview§r.
§eUse: §rCapture the current view, or pick a local PNG/JPG file.
§eResult: §rThe image is stored inside the .litematic file, so others see it in §bLitematica§r.

§6Function: §rSets whether the schematic list prefers the 3D preview or the stored preview image.
§eOn: §rThe list always shows a draggable 3D preview.
§eOff: §rA stored image is shown when present; the 3D preview still appears without one.

§6Function: §rUnder §bLitematica§r Easy Place, gives the §bright click§r back to vanilla for the categories below.
§7Note: §rEasy Place fakes sneaking and places first; this switch lets §bright click§r through.
§7Limit: §rOnly enabled categories are released; everything else keeps §bright click§r with Easy Place.

§6Function: §rUses plain ice for still water sources in the schematic.
§eScope: §rSingle and connected sources, plus bubble columns from soul sand or magma blocks.
§7Limit: §rNever packed or blue ice, and flowing water is not handled.

§6Function: §rLets Easy Place open vanilla block screens with §bright click§r.
§eScope: §rChests, furnaces, brewing stands, anvils, enchanting tables, beacons, and more.
§7Note: §rProjection container autofill waits for the target screen to open.

§6Function: §rLets Easy Place perform redstone-block §bright-click§r interactions.
§eScope: §rLevers, buttons, wooden and iron doors, copper bulbs, bells, note blocks, repeaters, and more.
§7Note: §rRuns the vanilla toggle, ring, tune, or light actions.

§6Function: §rLets Easy Place perform functional-block §bright-click§r interactions.
§eScope: §rComposters, jukeboxes, chiseled bookshelves, and decorated pots.
§7Note: §rVanilla rules govern inserting, taking, and operating their contents.

§6Function: §rLets Easy Place perform fluid-related §bright-click§r interactions.
§eScope: §rWater buckets, cauldron fill/drain for water, lava and powder snow, water bottles.
§7Note: §rOnly passes through with the matching vanilla item in hand.

§6Function: §rLets Easy Place perform tool-based block interactions with §bright click§r.
§eScope: §rAxe stripping and scraping, shovel paths, hoe tilling, shears carving pumpkins, and more.
§7Note: §rPasses through only when the tool has a vanilla action on that block.

§6Function: §rLets Easy Place perform decoration-block §bright-click§r interactions.
§eScope: §rSign editing, flower pots, fence leads, campfire cooking, and more.
§7Note: §rVanilla still decides the result from the held item and block state.

§6Function: §rLets Easy Place perform survival-block §bright-click§r interactions.
§eScope: §rSweet berry bushes, cave vines, beehives, cakes, beds, and campfires.
§7Note: §rCovers harvesting, honey collection, eating, and sleeping.

§6Function: §rLets Easy Place perform special-block §bright-click§r interactions.
§eScope: §rEyes of ender into portal frames, respawn anchor charging, trial vaults, dragon eggs, and more.
§7Note: §rDangerous and administrator interactions only work when this option is on too.

§6Function: §rLets Easy Place ignite §bTNT§r.
§eScope: §rFlint and steel or fire charges used with §bright click§r on TNT.
§eRequirement: §rAlso enable “Special Block Interactions”; this switch alone does nothing.
§cWarning: §rThe TNT explodes immediately after ignition.

§6Function: §rLets Easy Place open the vanilla screens of administrator blocks.
§eScope: §rCommand, jigsaw, structure, and light blocks in Creative mode.
§eRequirement: §rAlso enable “Special Block Interactions”; this switch alone does nothing.
§cWarning: §rVanilla permissions and server rules still apply.

§6Function: §rWhile §bLitematica§r is in Easy Place mode, keeps trying to place the targeted block.
§7Note: §rNo need to hold Easy Place's activation key.

§6Function: §rWhen enabled, press §bAlt + E§r to open the projection entity selector and request placement.
§cWarning: §rThe server needs §bCarpet-FGA Addition§r installed with the matching rule enabled.
§7Note: §rSingleplayer and integrated servers check only this switch, not the rule.
§7Note: §rThe server validates and consumes the required materials.
§7Rebind: §rThe binding can be changed under §bHotkeys§r.

§6Function: §rPlacing schematic entities in Creative skips material checks and costs.
§7Note: §rThe server still verifies that the player really is in Creative.
§7Note: §rOutside Creative, entity materials are checked as usual.

§6Function: §rSets whether passengers spawn with their vehicle and count toward materials.
§eOn: §rPassengers spawn with the vehicle; the whole passenger tree's materials are required.
§eOff: §rOnly the root entity is placed, e.g. a boat carrying a sheep places just the boat.

§6Function: §rSets whether entity containers spawn with their schematic contents and count toward materials.
§eOn: §rCreated from the schematic contents, which are validated and consumed.
§eOff: §rOnly an empty chest boat, storage minecart, or similar container is placed.

§6Function: §rWait before retrying the same position after a successful continuous Easy Place.
§7Note: §rAffects only this feature's wait and does not change Litematica's behavior.

§6Function: §rShows an open schematic folder button in the §bLitematica§r main menu.
§eUsage: §rClicking it opens the current schematic directory in the system file manager.

§6Function: §rShows a container material list button on §bLitematica§r's load schematic screen.
§eScope: §rCounts the items saved in each container's slots in the schematic.

§6Function: §rShows an entity material button on schematic material lists, container lists, and details.
§eScope: §rCounts placeable entities, items in frames, and armor stand equipment.
§7Limit: §rGolems and the wither convert to spawn materials; other mobs, entity inventories, and drops do not count.

quickcraft.config.projection_tools.comme: §6Function: §rShows slot error highlights and missing-item ghosts when opening projection containers.

§6Function: §rShows container fill verification categories in the §bLitematica§r verifier.
§7Note: §rCounts container slot contents and crafter locked-slot state.

§6Function: §rHighlights matching containers whose projection holds items while the real one is still empty.
§7Note: §rAny item in the real container clears the highlight; types, counts, and slots are not compared.
§7Note: §rWithout inventory sync, the last opened-container record is used; unknown contents stay highlighted.
§6Function: §rSets the highlight color of the projection container overlay.

§6Function: §rWhile a material list HUD is visible, hold §bright click§r and sweep containers to collect silently.
§eScope: §rWorks only with the §bLitematica§r and §bQuickCraft§r material list HUDs.
§eRequirement: §rTaking items from shulker boxes needs Quick Shulker enabled.
§7Note: §rWhen the inventory is full, an empty shulker from the container packs items; on release, the temporary box returns first.
§6Function: §rExtra amount taken when a single item is missing §b≤10§r.
§6Function: §rExtra amount taken when a single item is missing §b10–20§r.
§6Function: §rExtra amount taken when a single item is missing §b20–50§r.
§6Function: §rExtra amount taken when a single item is missing §b50–100§r.
§6Function: §rExtra amount taken when a single item is missing §b100–500§r.
§6Function: §rExtra amount taken when a single item is missing §b500+§r.

§6Function: §rWhen you §bright click§r the container matching a projection, it autofills from the schematic.
§eRequirement: §rTaking items from shulker boxes needs §bQuick Shulker§r enabled.
§eScope: §rUses the items and slot contents this container saved in the schematic.

§6Function: §rIn Creative mode, copying or filling projection containers creates the required items directly.
§7Note: §rNo inventory materials are consumed; the target container is filled from the schematic template.
§7Note: §rDoes nothing outside Creative; materials are still consumed from the inventory.

§6Function: §rAllows extra items from fill or copy cleanup to be dropped on the ground.
§7Note: §rItems go back to the inventory first; with Quick Shulker on, boxing them is tried next.
§7Limit: §rFull stacks are dropped only when they still cannot fit.

§6Function: §rMinimum inventory slots kept free before a Quick Shulker batch take.
§7Note: §rWhen short on space, non-protected items are boxed until the target is met.
§7Note: §r§b0§r means free as many slots as possible except protected items.

§6Function: §rItems protected while freeing inventory slots; they are not temporarily boxed.
